title: The Bernoulli Hash Function: Optimal Bernoulli Sets and Bernoulli Maps
description: Final version (October 2026), with errata; superseded by the monograph Bernoulli Types: Two-Sided Error in Approximate Membership, Retrieval, and Computation, Chapter 14. The Bernoulli hash function (BHF): seed-search constructions of Bernoulli sets and maps whose expected salt length matches the known -log2(epsilon)+mu scale, in exponential expected time, in the lineage of RecSplit and ShockHash. This version corrects the order-statistic law and withdraws the adaptive-threshold space saving.
